name: @aobplatform/aobprinter
description: AOBPRINTER — the desktop half of the DB4 print channel (DB4-AND-AOBL.md §5, §13 piece 5). A virtual printer the practice prints its PracSoft DB4 to; the spooled PDF is claimed, parsed into a DB4 Print Record by a versioned template, and posted to POST /inbound/print-jobs through a durable on-disk outbox. Nothing it does may slow or block printing (hard rule 8).
